title.en: Mechanism of evolution and Hardy–Weinberg principle

heading.en: When does a population stop changing?

hook.en: If nothing disturbs a population, its allele frequencies stay the same generation after generation. Evolution is what happens when something disturbs that balance.
hook.kn: ಏನೂ ಅಡ್ಡಿಯಾಗದಿದ್ದರೆ ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯ ಅಲೀಲ್ ಆವರ್ತನಗಳು ಪೀಳಿಗೆಯಿಂದ ಪೀಳಿಗೆಗೆ ಬದಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಆ ಸಮತೋಲನ ಕದಡಿದಾಗ ವಿಕಾಸ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: If nothing disturbs a population, its allele frequencies stay the same generation after generation. Evolution is what happens when something disturbs that balance.
narration.kn: ಏನೂ ಅಡ್ಡಿಯಾಗದಿದ್ದರೆ ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯ ಅಲೀಲ್ ಆವರ್ತನಗಳು ಪೀಳಿಗೆಯಿಂದ ಪೀಳಿಗೆಗೆ ಬದಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಆ ಸಮತೋಲನ ಕದಡಿದಾಗ ವಿಕಾಸ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: In a population, allele frequencies are stable and constant from generation to generation; the gene pool remains constant. This is genetic equilibrium. If p and q are the frequencies of two alleles, then p + q = 1 and the genotype frequencies are p², 2pq and q², which add up to 1. When the measured frequencies differ from these expected values, the difference shows the extent of evolutionary change.
body.kn: ಹಾರ್ಡಿ–ವೈನ್‌ಬರ್ಗ್ ತತ್ವ: ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಲೀಲ್ ಆವರ್ತನಗಳು ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿರುತ್ತವೆ. p + q = 1; p² + 2pq + q² = 1. ಇದರಿಂದ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ಕಂಡರೆ ವಿಕಾಸ ಆಗುತ್ತಿದೆ.

narration.en: In a population, allele frequencies are stable and constant from generation to generation; the gene pool remains constant. This is genetic equilibrium. If p and q are the frequencies of two alleles, then p + q = 1 and the genotype frequencies are p², 2pq and q², which add up to 1. When the measured frequencies differ from these expected values, the difference shows the extent of evolutionary change.
narration.kn: ಹಾರ್ಡಿ–ವೈನ್‌ಬರ್ಗ್ ತತ್ವ: ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಲೀಲ್ ಆವರ್ತನಗಳು ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿರುತ್ತವೆ. p + q = 1; p² + 2pq + q² = 1. ಇದರಿಂದ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ಕಂಡರೆ ವಿಕಾಸ ಆಗುತ್ತಿದೆ.

body.en: Five factors affect Hardy–Weinberg equilibrium: gene migration or gene flow, genetic drift, mutation, genetic recombination and natural selection. When genes move between populations, frequencies change (gene flow); if the change happens by chance it is genetic drift. Sometimes the change is so large that a few founders form a different population: the founder effect. Natural selection can be stabilising (more individuals take the mean value), directional (more take a value other than the mean) or disruptive (more individuals at both ends of the distribution).
body.kn: ಸಮತೋಲನವನ್ನು ಐದು ಅಂಶಗಳು ಕದಡುತ್ತವೆ: ಜೀನ್ ಪ್ರವಾಹ, ಆನುವಂಶಿಕ ದಿಕ್ಚ್ಯುತಿ, ಉತ್ಪರಿವರ್ತನೆ, ಪುನರ್ಸಂಯೋಜನೆ ಮತ್ತು ನೈಸರ್ಗಿಕ ಆಯ್ಕೆ. ನೈಸರ್ಗಿಕ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಸ್ಥಿರಗೊಳಿಸುವ, ದಿಕ್ಕಿನ ಅಥವಾ ವಿಚ್ಛೇದಕ ಆಗಿರಬಹುದು.

aim.en: To find allele frequencies from genotype counts and test whether a population is in Hardy–Weinberg equilibrium.

narration.en: On this bench we count genotypes in a population, calculate p and q, and check whether the population is in equilibrium.

problem.en: In a population in Hardy–Weinberg equilibrium, 16% of individuals show a recessive trait (aa). Find p, q and the percentage of carriers (Aa).

problem.en: In a population of 1000, 360 are AA, 480 are Aa and 160 are aa. Find the frequency of allele A.

steps.en: Each person has two alleles: total = 2000.

body.en: In Hardy–Weinberg problems the recessive phenotype gives q² directly. Take its square root to get q, then p = 1 − q, then carriers = 2pq.

points.en: Hardy–Weinberg: allele frequencies stay constant without disturbance.
Five disturbing factors: gene flow, drift, mutation, recombination, selection.

narration.en: Recap. Hardy–Weinberg: allele frequencies stay constant without disturbance. p² + 2pq + q² = 1. Five disturbing factors: gene flow, drift, mutation, recombination, selection. Selection may be stabilising, directional or disruptive.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಹಾರ್ಡಿ–ವೈನ್‌ಬರ್ಗ್: ಅಡ್ಡಿಯಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಅಲೀಲ್ ಆವರ್ತನ ಸ್ಥಿರ. p² + 2pq + q² = 1. ಐದು ಅಂಶಗಳು: ಜೀನ್ ಪ್ರವಾಹ, ದಿಕ್ಚ್ಯುತಿ, ಉತ್ಪರಿವರ್ತನೆ, ಪುನರ್ಸಂಯೋಜನೆ, ಆಯ್ಕೆ. ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಸ್ಥಿರಗೊಳಿಸುವ, ದಿಕ್ಕಿನ ಅಥವಾ ವಿಚ್ಛೇದಕ.
